free_tier_limits: 100 free testing credits after registration. Each successful identification costs 1 credit; including plant.health in the same request costs 1 additional credit.
rate_limits: No request-count cap. SLA processing guarantees apply up to 20 uploaded photos/minute for tiers A-B, 60 for tier C, and 240 for tier D+ or retroactive pay; higher traffic may be queued or slower.
example_request: curl -X POST 'https://api.plant.id/v3/identification?details=common_names' -H 'Api-Key: YOUR_API_KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data "{\"images\":[\"$(base64 < plant.jpg | tr -d '\n')\"]}"
resolution_notes: free_tier_limits corrected: the FAQ specifies 100 signup credits, 1 per identification, plus 1 for plant.health: https://www.kindwise.com/faq. rate_limits corrected: the FAQ says no request cap; the SLA gives 20/60/240 photos-per-minute performance thresholds: https://www.kindwise.com/service-level-agreement. example corrected: official code sends plain Base64 without a data-URL prefix and its sample confirms the response shape: https://github.com/flowerchecker/plant-id-examples.
